icons.name: fonts
icons.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Neotrix Prism client asset category card icon. ONE premium original sculpted 3D object isolated with genuine transparent alpha. Matching icon family: glossy violet glass and enamel, electric cyan details, rose pink accent, pronounced solid extrusion about 20% width, smooth rounded substantial bevels, realistic ambient occlusion, controlled upper-left studio highlights. Nearly frontal camera 12 degrees above, 15 degrees left. Big simple readable silhouette with few coherent features, no clutter. Centered square composition occupying 72%, safe transparent margin all sides. No backdrop, checkerboard, ground plane, pedestal, label or watermark. Avoid flat vector graphics and generic yellow folders.
Subject: two large thick freestanding sculpted letterforms capital A and lowercase a, side by side as one typographic font icon. Violet glass capital A and cyan enamel lowercase a with a subtle rose accent on the extruded sides. Text exactly 'Aa'; no other lettering.
